title: Study Buddy App Distribution Project
summary: Study Buddy App for students for Maharashtra State Board was distributed on 26-09-2026 at Pandurang Vidyalaya, LBS Road, Mulund West, Shrinagar Vidyamandir at Shrinagar, Thane West and Omega School at Khindi Pada, Bhandup West.
description:
Study Buddy App for students for Maharashtra State Board was distributed on 26-09-2026 at Pandurang Vidyalaya, LBS Road, Mulund West, Shrinagar Vidyamandir at Shrinagar, Thane West and Omega School at Khindi Pada, Bhandup West.
Rtn. Varsha Kolhatkar (Project Chair), Rtn. Chander Kant Suri, Rtn. Kailas Satanekar, Rtn. Rajnikant Parikh and Rtn. Vinod Chaube attended the project.
